header.running_head: Hadhrat Umar (RA) Gives Preference to those who were the First to Migrate over the Popular Leaders of People

blocks.text: Hadhrat Suhayl bin Amr (RA) came and sat with Hadhrat Umar (RA) in a manner that he was between the two of them. Thereafter, the first among those to migrate to Madinah started arriving. (As each one of them arrived,) Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Move aside, O Suhayl! Move aside, O Haarith!" In this manner, Hadhrat Umar (RA) moved the two of them further from himself. As the Ansaar started coming to Hadhrat Umar (RA), he moved the two men further in a like manner until they were behind everyone. When the two men left the presence of Hadhrat Umar (RA), Hadhrat Haarith bin Hishaam (RA) said to Hadhrat Suhayl bin Amr (RA), "Did you see how we were treated?" Hadhrat Suhayl (RA) replied, "Dear man! We should not blame Hadhrat Umar (RA), but should blame ourselves. When those people were invited to accept Islaam, they were quick to do so while we procrastinated." When the Muhaajireen and Ansaar had left Hadhrat Umar (RA), the two men approached him and said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! We noticed what you did today and realise that is was due to our own shortcomings. However, is there any way in which we could gain the status we have not been able to achieve?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to them, "I know of no other way but in that direction." He then pointed towards the Roman borders (where the Muslims were waging Jihaad against the Romans). The two men then left for Shaam, where they both passed away.[^1]
The Statement of Hadhrat Suhayl bin Amr (RA) to the Leaders over Whom Hadhrat Umar (RA) had Given preference to the Early Muhaajireen

Hadhrat Hasan (RAH) narrates that several persons came to the door of Hadhrat Umar (RA). Amongst them were Hadhrat Suhayl bin Amr (RA), Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan bin Harb (RA) and other prominent leaders of the Quraysh (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s doorkeeper came out and allowed inside those Sahabah (RA) who participated in the Battle of Badr such as Hadhrat Suhayb (RA), Hadhrat Bilaal (RA) and Hadhrat Ammaar (RA). Hadhrat Hasan (RAH) says, "I swear by Allaah that Hadhrat Umar (RA) had himself participated in the Battle of Badr. He loved those who participated in the Battle of Badr and always advised others to show preference to them. Abu Sufyaan (RA) said, "I have never before seen a day like today! He allows these slaves to enter without paying any attention to us sitting there." Hadhrat Hasan (RAH) narrates further by saying, "Hadhrat Suhayl bin Amr (RA) responded to him. What an excellent and intelligent man he was! He said, 'O people! By Allaah! I see the expressions on your faces. If you are angry, be angry with yourselves. You were also invited to accept Islaam when these people were invited. However, they were quick to respond while you procrastinated. Listen well!
